trail.name: Leigh Lake
trail.coordinateNote: Official NPS Leigh Lake Trailhead marker, 3.4 m from the shared NPS approach. This is a trailhead-area forecast, not the southern parking-access start or a guarantee of conditions along the entire hike.

additionalSources.note: NPS route configuration identifies the shared Leigh Lake approach and the intended short southern-shore turnaround, not an eastern-shore extension.

comparison.note: The full official NPS approach plus two connected NPS-origin USGS segments, retraced on return, total 1.766 miles, 1.9% below NPS. The southern access leg is retained; extra shore and camping spurs are excluded.

photo.alt: Clear waves roll onto the shore of Leigh Lake below forested slopes and snow-streaked Teton peaks.
photo.permissionNote: The corresponding official activity page credits NPS Photo/A. Falgoust and displays no third-party restriction. Retain the credit and source link; no endorsement is implied. The original 6016 x 3384 JPEG was visually reviewed without upscaling.
